steps_h2: How to Make Product Feature Callout Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Turn one product photo into a clear feature video shoppers can understand at a glance.

steps.d: Add one clear source photo and keep the full product and moving part visible. Use even light so the feature stays easy to read.
Choose one action and describe the setting shoppers should see. Keep the moving part in frame for the result.
Download the result, add exact offer or listing details in your editor, then post. Check the feature, final copy and product details before publishing.

faq.a: Use a sharp, well-lit photo that shows the whole product and the feature clearly. Avoid glare, tight crops and hidden moving parts.

faq.q: What result does this template show?
faq.a: It creates a product feature callout video that keeps one visible action at the center. Compare the export with your source photo before publishing.

faq.q: Which length or format should I choose?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 for feeds and listings, or 16:9 for a product page. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds based on how much of the action shoppers need to see.

faq.q: Can I change details after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact names, prices, dates, measurements or ingredients in your editor after download. Review every detail against the real product before posting.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot day?
faq.a: No. Start from one clear product photo and choose a scene that fits the feature. Review the result before you decide whether another shoot is needed.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: Use the downloaded clip in your store, product page or paid social campaign. Add your own captions, offer details and any platform-required disclosure in the editor.

visual.overview: A feature callout video puts one visible function at the center of the frame. Show the moving part in a single action, then add the exact feature name and measurements in your editor.

steps.sourceAlt: Plain white cleanser pump bottle photographed alone on a light background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a clean sink, a hand presses the white cleanser pump once and catches a small amount of foam on fingertips. Keep the bottle upright and fully visible. Close three-quarter framing with a gentle push-in. Even task light over the counter. End with the cleanser upright and foam visible on the fingertips. Sound: single pump and quiet room tone, no music.
